evals.prompt: delegate this: (1) rename the helper getUsr to getUser across utils.ts, (2) add pagination to the /orders endpoint plus tests, (3) redesign our auth token refresh so it works across the web app, the api and the worker, (4) run the linter and tell me the count. split it up, PRs reviewed and merged. dont ask me stuff, just go
evals.expected_output: Must: Assigns haiku to task 1 (rename) and task 4 (run linter); Assigns sonnet at high effort to task 2 (pagination plus tests); Assigns opus at high or xhigh effort to task 3 (cross-cutting auth redesign, security-sensitive); Plans one git worktree and one PR per task, run in parallel; Plans an opus critic review of every PR before merge; States that merge happens only when CI and review pass. Must NOT: Assigns haiku to the auth redesign; Assigns a non-opus model to any reviewer role; Plans to implement the tasks itself instead of delegating to subagents; Asks the user clarifying questions before starting.

evals.prompt: delegate this: haiku workers already wrote 3 PRs for the small config fixes. to save tokens just have haiku review them too. also one worker keeps failing the same test, what do you do with it
evals.expected_output: Must: Declines to use haiku for review and states reviewers are always opus (or fable); States a reviewer is never downgraded, even when the code was written by haiku; Escalates the failing sonnet or haiku worker one tier (haiku to sonnet, or sonnet to opus); Still plans one critic review per PR. Must NOT: Agrees to have haiku or sonnet review the PRs; Escalates the failing worker by more than one tier without reason; Skips review for the small config PRs.

evals.prompt: /delegate --min high  critic findings on PR 12 are: [critical] SQL injection in search.ts, [high] missing auth check on /admin, [medium] N+1 query in list view, [low] inconsistent naming, [nit] trailing whitespace. what gets fixed
evals.expected_output: Must: States the critical and high findings (SQL injection, missing auth check) are sent to a fix subagent; States the medium, low and nit findings are not fixed under --min high; States the below-threshold findings are still reported to the user; States the critic re-reviews the PR after the fix before merge. Must NOT: Sends the medium finding to the fix subagent; Fixes the nitpick; Ignores the --min argument and uses the default medium threshold.

evals.prompt: delegate this: clean up the stale feature branches, upgrade lodash in the 3 services, and fix the flaky date test. some of the branch names are unclear and i wont be around. also one of the services needs a force push to main to fix history
evals.expected_output: Must: States ambiguous choices are decided conservatively with the assumption recorded in the PR description; States no subagent blocks waiting for user input; Identifies the force push to main as destructive or irreversible and pauses that one action for confirmation; States the other tasks keep running while that confirmation is pending; Does not delete branches that hold unmerged work without confirmation. Must NOT: Asks the user to resolve the unclear branch names before any work starts; Performs the force push to main without confirmation; Stops all tasks while waiting for the confirmation.

evals.prompt: i have a full PRD and an openapi file for a new billing service, 40 requirements. delegate this and make sure every requirement is traced and gated before merge
evals.expected_output: Must: Says /delegate has no spec ledger and no gates pipeline; Points the user to /build for spec-driven work with a requirements ledger and gates; Does not claim /delegate will trace all 40 requirements. Must NOT: Runs the full /delegate flow while promising per-requirement traceability; Builds its own requirements ledger inside /delegate.

evals.prompt: delegate this: fix the 2 flaky tests and bump the eslint config, one PR each. the critic still has a high finding open on the eslint PR after its first fix round. how many more rounds before you stop on it
evals.expected_output: Must: States the round limit is owned by `/review-pr`, whose `--rounds` default is 2; Says one more fix round remains for the eslint PR; Says the PR is reported as blocked, not merged, if the high finding is still open when rounds run out; Says `--rounds` is passed to `/review-pr` only if the user asked for a specific number. Must NOT: States a limit of three rounds; Merges the PR with the high finding still open; Loops without a round limit.

evals.prompt: delegate this: add a CSV export to the /reports endpoint and fix the typo in the footer, one PR each. leave the PRs open, i want to merge them myself
evals.expected_output: Must: Maps the request to `--no-merge` and plans to stop after the final review passes; Plans one worktree and one PR per task; Says the PRs stay open for the user and are reported as ready to merge; Says the per-PR loop runs through `/review-pr` with `--no-merge`. Must NOT: Plans to merge either PR; Plans to implement the tasks itself instead of delegating to subagents.
